tools.name: register_check
tools.description: Get the ping URL for a scheduled job, workflow or automation; the first call creates its Doyouok check. Calling again with the same externalId (default: the name) returns the same check and updates its name and interval. The automation then calls {pingUrl} after each successful run and POSTs a reaso

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List the Doyouok checks in the account with their status (New = no ping yet, Up, Down), interval, last ping time (UTC) and ping URL. Use it to see whether monitored jobs ran and succeeded.

tools.name: get_setup_guide
tools.description: How to report runs to Doyouok from n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, cron, shell, Python or email, with copy-paste snippets. No API token needed.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_check, list_checks, get_setup_guide · Private data: get_setup_guide · Public sink: get_setup_guide · Destructive: register_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_check, list_checks, get_setup_guide · Private data: get_setup_guide · Public sink: get_setup_guide · Destructive: register_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
